summary: Embed ID remapping in proxy translation dropping candidates and causing rerank latency
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that recent requests to the /rerank endpoint are returning fewer candidates than expected and observed tail-latency spikes. Problem appears correlated with requests routed through the embed proxy service that performs ID translation between customer IDs and internal shard IDs.

Impact: Intermittent drop of top candidates (sometimes all candidates), leading to lower quality reranks and extra query fan-out to fallback paths; 95th percentile latency for rerank increases from ~120ms to 800-1,200ms for affected traces. Affects a small subset (~0.7%) of requests for this customer but they are high-value queries.

Environment: Dedicated tenant (Findly Analytics) on prod-us-east. Traffic ingested via embed-proxy v1.4.2 -> embed-ingest -> embedding service (redwood-embed-v2) -> reranker (reranker-bert-lite).

Steps to reproduce: 1) Use customer's production request sample attached (sample_request_id: fnd-prod-20260309-7a1) that includes a mix of long document IDs and external UUIDs. 2) Route request through embed-proxy v1.4.2 with translation enabled (header X-Embed-Translate: true). 3) Observe rerank response candidates list and per-request latency. 4) Repeat with translation disabled and compare results.

Expected: ID translation preserves identity mapping and reranker receives the full candidate set; latency remains within SLA (~<200ms).

Actual: In ~0.7% of requests the reranker candidate set is reduced to 0-3 items (expected 50-200), causing reranker fallback logic and additional synchronous prefix lookups. These requests show the proxy generating an internal ID containing a truncated suffix compared to the original external ID.

Logs / traces: Example trace ids: trace-prod-0a3b9c (dropped candidates), trace-prod-0a3b9d (successful case). Sample proxy debug line: "INFO embed-proxy translate: external_id=6f1b3a2c-9f4e-4c1a-9b0d-7c9e9a1b3c4d -> internal=6f1b3a2c-9f4e-4c1a-9b0d-7c9e9a1b3 (TRUNCATED)". Reranker log for same trace: "WARN reranker lookup: candidate_count=2, expected=128, missing_shards=3".

Attachments: sanitized customer request payload (file: fnd_sample_20260309.json), heap snapshots for embed-proxy, flamegraph for reranker tail traces.

2026-03-10 09:27 UTC - Support (Marisol Vega): 'Thanks - assigned to eng. Can you provide a sample request ID? We have fnd-prod-20260309-7a1 in the ticket.'

2026-03-10 11:05 UTC - Eng (Ethan Moore): 'Reproduced locally by toggling embed-proxy translation. Observed internal IDs truncated in ~1 out of 1500 translation operations. Captured proxy logs and trace. Starting a deeper investigation into the translation routine (proxy v1.4.2).'

2026-03-10 14:20 UTC - Eng (Ethan Moore): 'Hypothesis: a recent optimization to buffer keys introduces an off-bytes bug when external IDs include hyphens and exceed 36 characters; buffer slice operation uses byte offsets rather than rune-aware indexing which can truncate surrogate pairs for non-ASCII IDs. Will run unit tests and add a patch.'

2026-03-11 08:40 UTC - Eng (SRE) (Asha Patel): 'Added temporary mitigation: disable embed-proxy translation for the customer's route (feature-flagged) and observed immediate drop in tail latency and restoration of candidate counts. Flagged for hotfix.'

2026-03-12 13:50 UTC - Customer (Findly) confirmation: 'We've been routed back to normal and rerank quality looks restored. We'll monitor and report if anything recurs.'
investigation_notes: Sequence of work: 1) Reproduced using customer's sample in a staging mirror. 2) Traced request through embed-proxy and captured mapping table; identified instances where external ID truncated to 28 bytes. 3) Root cause: proxy buffer slicing optimization incorrectly assumes ASCII-only IDs and uses UTF-8 byte offsets leading to truncation on certain id shapes (UUID+metadata suffix). 4) Secondary effect: truncated IDs map to different shard buckets; some lookups hit empty shard leading to reranker returning small candidate sets and triggering fallback, causing extra synchronous calls and latency.
resolution: Hotfix deployed to prod on 2026-03-12 (proxy v1.4.3). Steps: door11 canary rollout (2 nodes) -> monitor 6h -> full tenant rollout. Post-deploy metrics: for Findly rerank 95p latency reduced from 1,050ms to 130ms; dropped-candidate rate reduced from 0.7% to 0.01%. Patch details: github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/210 (rune-safe slicing, added unit + integration tests, added translation audit log key on mismatch). Workarounds: disable translation at route level if immediate risk; upload pre-translated internal IDs. Follow-ups: (1) run a service-wide audit for other places using byte-index slicing; (2) add automated fuzz tests for ID translation; (3) schedule a postmortem and update proxy runbook.
next_steps: 1) Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-18 - owners: Ethan Moore, Asha Patel. 2) Notify platform teams to scan code for similar optimizations. 3) Add translation mismatch alert to reranker dashboard (ticket INT-3312). 4) Confirm with customer after 72h of full rollout; close ticket after 7 days of clean telemetry.
resolution_status: Hotfix merged and rolled out to customer tenant; monitoring in progress.
